title: Startup "Profile password" prompt silently replaces the connections file with an empty profile database
author: SmearODeer
body_snippet:
## Summary
On `v1.78.2-dev`, every startup shows a **"Profile password"** prompt. If the user types a password, which is the natural response to a password prompt, mRemoteNG silently switches to a new, empty SQLite profile database, and their connections file is never loaded. The Connections tree comes up empty, and any connection created from then on is saved to the profile database rather than to the file.
